name: MiroFish (official source, Codespaces)
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; npm run setup:all'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ -n "${LLM_API_KEY:-}" ] && [ -n "${ZEP_API_KEY:-}" ]; then nohup npm run dev > /tmp/mirofish-dev.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & else nohup npm run frontend > /tmp/mirofish-frontend.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & fi'
